mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with haloperidol (dopamine antagonist) increases serotonin syndrome risk and CNS depression, with potential for additive effects on serotonergic and dopaminergic pathways.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and CNS depression; consider alternative antipsychotic with less serotonergic interaction or alternative migraine therapy if possible.
